# temps_sandbox_placement (Resource)

Which nodes may run AI agent sandboxes. Destroying the resource allows every node again.

Import with `sandbox_placement`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run AI sandboxes only on node 2.
resource "temps_sandbox_placement" "this" {
  allowed_node_ids = [2]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowed_node_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the nodes sandboxes may run on.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `sandbox_placement`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: the import ID is the resource type without the prefix.
terraform import temps_sandbox_placement.this sandbox_placement
```
